text:
elaine: Heads-up — Python SDK 0.22.0 rolled in automatic route-augmentation for internal telemetry (adds X-Redwood-Route meta). I started a canary and noticed console shows double-counted tokens for some routes. Anyone else seeing this?

simon: yup saw a spike. looks like header gets added both client-side and by platform proxy. :grimacing:

aj: can you paste example header? Could be header name clash or casing issue.

elaine: example from py client:
```
headers={'X-Redwood-Route':'tenant:billing,priority:low', 'x-redwood-sample':'1'}
```
platform proxy also sets `X-Redwood-Route` when routing fallback kicks in.

maria: ah — proxy sets route for fallback path, SDK adds for intent propagation. If both present we end up concatenating in console mapping which increments token attribution (console splits by comma naively).

simon: so two problems: header canonicalization and console parser leniency. propose:
- make SDK opt-outable (env var) for auto-augment
- change SDK to use `X-Redwood-Route-V1` for now
- patch console parser to dedupe and trim

elaine: +1 on opt-out env var. migration path: SDK v0.22 default on, v0.23 will switch to V1 header with deprecation warning, then v0.24 turn off original? we need non-breaking.

aj: roadmap sounds ok. also add telemetry flag so sampling uses same id to avoid double-sampling counts.

platform-bot: FYI: created infra ticket INFRA-4321 to change proxy to prefer existing header over setting new one.

maria: small UX ask — when console shows route attribution, add tooltip "merged headers from client + proxy" so customers see sources.

elaine: agree. Action items:
- @simon add SDK opt-out env var + unit tests (py)
- @aj open PR to use `X-Redwood-Route-V1` and deprecate log
- @maria patch console parser to canonicalize and dedupe
- infra to update proxy behavior (INFRA-4321)
- schedule a canary across 10% of accounts next week

simon: I'll do opt-out PR today. draft header change example:
```
# opt out
export REDWOOD_CLIENT_ROUTE_AUGMENT=false

# new header
headers['X-Redwood-Route-V1']='tenant=billing;priority=low'
```

aj: also need release note and mention in migration guide + SDK changelog.

elaine: cool — let's keep channel for updates. if anyone hits discrepancies dm me. :thumbsup:
